title: Fomo Kernel Prose-only Narrative
$comment: The prose-only, no-numbers rule is enforced authoritatively by engine/card_renderer.py:validate_narrative (issue #194 item 1). It rejects ASCII/Unicode digits AND spelled-out quantity claims in both languages (三成, 五萬, 兩倍, 百分之三十, thirty percent). ECMA-262 schema patterns cannot express the CJK/word-form rule, and the former per-field '^\D+$' matched ASCII digits only — it accepted full-width digits (３０) that the engine's Unicode \d rejects, so the two layers disagreed. The pattern is removed so this schema no longer makes a weaker, contradictory claim; card_renderer.validate_narrative is the single source of truth for digit-ban. #773: this file's `properties` set must equal card_renderer.ALLOWED_NARRATIVE, including fields no renderer consumes on any route (`rule_rationale`) — dropping an accepted-but-unrendered field from `properties` would fail a documented-safe `finalize` retry on an old committed session that recorded it (replay re-validates the *stored* narrative, not a fresh one). See `rule_rationale` and `counterfactual` below, and `card_renderer.narrative_fields_not_rendered` / `review_plan.authoring_contract.narrative.not_rendered_on_this_route`, for what is accepted but not rendered and why.

counterfactual.description: Accepted on every route, but consumed only where a diagnosed behavioral hole exists to pair it with -- a snapshot_review has no transaction history to diagnose one from, so its card never renders this field even when supplied. See card_renderer.NARRATIVE_FIELDS_NOT_RENDERED_BY_ROUTE and review_plan.authoring_contract.narrative.not_rendered_on_this_route (#773).

rule_rationale.description: Accepted for replay compatibility only -- no renderer consumes this field on any route (the engine's own derived trade-off sentence is what the card shows; an authored restatement would duplicate it). Do not author it: see flows/first-review.md and card_renderer.NARRATIVE_FIELDS_NEVER_RENDERED (#773).

synthesis.description: Optional closing synthesis (#345): two to three sentences that condense the period's single most important cross-section judgment into one point of view, rendered as the card's final section, after Block 4 (Next step). It must connect facts that otherwise sit in separate sections (for example: concentration level + dollar exposure + what a drawdown would mean) into one conclusion — it must never restate a number, tile, or sentence that already appears elsewhere on the card. Omit the field entirely, rather than writing a placeholder, when nothing rises to that synthesis; the renderer drops the section with no header when the field is absent.

honesty.description: One qualitative sentence per triggered honesty-ledger key; preview fails unless every required_honesty_keys entry is covered (#82: conditions live in the engine, wording stays with the agent). Digit-ban is enforced by card_renderer.validate_narrative, not by a schema pattern (see top-level $comment).
